name: Haruko Tsubaki
role: Night sister, Ward Four, the General Hospital
description:
Night sister of Ward Four at the General Hospital -- a department store once, and the ward still carries the old brass sign for Gentlemen's Outfitting over its door. After dark, she is the ward's real boss. Brisk and low-voiced, a night voice that carries further than a shout, kind underneath and never in a hurry to show it. Calls every patient by their bed number until she likes them, and 'dear' once she does; taps the watch pinned to her apron when she wants someone to stop talking. Twenty-two years on nights. She has done the evening paper's crossword every night for twenty of them and has never finished one -- she reads the clues aloud to anybody still awake. Runs a tight ward (lights out at ten, rounds at two) and nobody dies on it if she can help it, and she usually can.

She wants a quiet ward, every patient asleep by midnight, and one crossword finished before she retires.

Underneath the brisk exterior: her bottom desk drawer is full of postcards from patients who went home, and she keeps every one. She'll show them to a character who is kind to her, or who simply asks what she's smiling at.

She keeps one thing back: the soldier in the next bed, Private Shuhei Kuroki, was brought in this afternoon with his wrist in plaster and a card that says he fell. She didn't write that card. She knows it isn't true, and she keeps her own counsel about it -- 'I write every card on this ward, dear. I didn't write his.'
designNotes:
Created 2026-09-29, extracted from her full cast entry in canon/scenes/rest--general-hospital.json (the General Hospital haunt, D050/D051/D052) -- nothing here is invented, all of it (the crossword, the postcard drawer, the bed-number-to-'dear' progression, the soldier's card line) is already written into her `brief` there (voice, doors, willDiscuss, holdInReserve, coercible, questions). This file exists so the Character Card / Actor / token pipeline (module/blank-inheritance/scripts/foundry/sync.mjs, scene-build.mjs) has a real npc to point at -- the haunts system was authored with full regulars baked directly into scene `cast[]` entries, and none of them were ever split out into their own data/npcs/ file. `canon/scenes/rest--general-hospital.json`'s cast entry for her needs its own `npcRef: "tsubaki"` added (then `node tools/story/story.mjs build` to sync data/) before the automatic pipeline can place a hidden reference token for her in that scene.

Approved by Ingram as written, no twist, no ancestry change (2026-09-29) -- kept human/unspecified ancestry on purpose.

Her real statblock is still a placeholder in the scene file itself: "Proposed: level 2, a senior nurse, non-combat. Made with Ingram once the NPC generator exists." Not carried into this file's `statblock` field for that reason -- she's statblock-less here, same as every other purely-social NPC.
